home.a1: No. Nothing is scanned until you pick a chat, and only the chats you pick are read.

home.description: TMPlayer Music is a player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. Free and open source for Android 6.0 and up. Unofficial, not affiliated with Telegram.
home.f_cache: A cache limit and Free up space, which never touches anything in Telegram.
home.f_library: Songs, Albums and Artists with an A to Z index and search, built from the chats you pick.
home.f_lyrics: From the tags or a matching .lrc file, with the current line lit.
home.f_queue: Reorder it, take tracks out, and find it whole after a restart.
home.f_stream: Start a track before the file is whole, and seek before it ends.
home.f_versions: The same song in several files is one row, with a Versions sheet behind it.
home.get_p: Android {android} and newer, {size} MB. Free and open source.
home.hero_albums_alt: The Albums tab: a grid of album covers.
home.hero_home_alt: The Home screen with its Speed dial of track covers.
home.hero_now_alt: Now Playing: a large cover, a seek bar and the playback buttons.
home.is1: A player for audio files that are already in your own chats.
home.is2: Free and open source, with no ads of its own and no paid tier.
home.is3: Built to stream and seek files while they download.
home.is_h: What it is, and what it is not
home.lede: A player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. Free and open source, for Android 6.0 and newer. Below is how it looks.
home.not1: A catalogue, a store or a search for music to find.
home.not2: An official Telegram app: it is unofficial and not affiliated.
home.not3: A way around a chat's rules: files a chat does not allow to be saved are skipped.
home.q1: Does it read all my chats?
home.q3: Is it an official Telegram app?
home.shot_account: Settings, the chats that are read, Send logs and Log out, one tap from Home.
home.shot_account_alt: The account menu open over Home: the signed in account, Settings, Manage chats, Send logs, About and Log out.
home.shot_albums: Tracks grouped by album artist, album and year, read from the tags in the files.
home.shot_albums_alt: The Albums tab: a grid of album covers with their artists.
home.shot_chats: Each chat you picked opens as a playlist of its tracks.
home.shot_chats_alt: The Chats screen: chats with their track counts and a play button each.
home.shot_home: Speed dial keeps the tracks you come back to one tap away, with what you played recently below.
home.shot_home_alt: The Home screen: a Speed dial grid of track covers, a Shuffle all button and Recently played.
home.shot_lyrics: Synced lyrics follow the track, the current line lit.
home.shot_lyrics_alt: The lyrics page of Now Playing: lines of lyrics with the current one in bold white.
home.shot_nowplaying: The cover, a seek bar, shuffle and repeat.
home.shot_nowplaying_alt: Now Playing: a large cover, the track title and artist, a seek bar and the playback buttons.
home.shot_queue: See what plays next, reorder it or take tracks out.
home.shot_queue_alt: The queue sheet over Now Playing: seven tracks with drag handles and remove buttons.
home.shot_songs: Every track from your chats in one list, with an A to Z index.
home.shot_songs_alt: The Library on its Songs tab: tracks with covers, artists and lengths, and an A to Z index on the side.
home.shots_note: The screenshots use demo data: every track, album, artist and chat name in them is invented.
home.start_h: Up and playing in four steps
home.step1: Download it on an Android 6.0 or newer phone and allow the install. {a1}
home.step2: You sign in to Telegram inside the app, with your own account. The app has no account of ours.
home.step2_h: Sign in with your own account
home.step3: Nothing is scanned until you choose a chat. You can change the list or remove a chat at any time.
home.step4: Tracks start while the file is still downloading, and the queue is there after a restart.
home.title: TMPlayer Music: audio files from your Telegram chats
home.what_h: Your chats already hold the music
home.what_lede: Friends send tracks, groups keep albums, you save files to yourself. TMPlayer Music turns the chats you pick into a library you can browse and play, and reads nothing else.

sponsor.offer_why_text: TMPlayer Music has no ads of its own, no paid tier and no account of ours. A coffee or a sponsorship pays for the time each release takes. It is voluntary and unlocks nothing: every feature is free for everyone.
